name: personal-data-for-garmin-connect
description: Community plugin, not made or endorsed by Garmin. Read-only MCP tools for your own Garmin Connect data (sleep, HRV, resting HR, Body Battery, stress, daily summaries, activities, original .FIT files) using your own Garmin Connect Personal API key.

GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.title: Garmin Connect Personal API key
GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.description: Your own key from https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken (shown once when created). Expires after the period you chose (30 days to 1 year); paste a new key here to renew.
